description: This file contains build definitions, macros, and functions for packaging OpenWrt software packages, including support for ipkg and apk package formats. It defines how to generate package files, handle dependencies, and create control files for packaging.

methods.name: description_escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in package description for control files.

methods.name: gen_package_wildcard
methods.description: Generates a wildcard pattern for candidate ipkg files based on package name and ABI.

methods.name: maybe_use_xargs
methods.description: Runs a command with arguments, using xargs if arguments exceed a certain size.

methods.name: remove_ipkg_files
methods.description: Removes ipkg files for a package using a generated list.

methods.name: BuildPackVariable
methods.description: Defines package variables and scripts for build process.

methods.name: FormatDepends
methods.description: Formats dependency lists, handling ABI versions and constraints.

methods.name: AddProvide
methods.description: Adds provide entries with optional ABI and version suffixes.

methods.name: SanitizeProvides
methods.description: Removes self and virtual provides prefixes from provides list.

methods.name: FormatProvides
methods.description: Formats provides list with ABI and version considerations for control and apk.

methods.name: GetProviderPriority
methods.description: Determines provider priority based on default variant and ABI version.

methods.name: CheckDependencies
methods.description: Checks for missing dependencies for a package.
